name: westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_set_status_text_fmt
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::SetStatusTextFmt formats progress text into the recovered global buffer and pushes it to the progress dialog status control.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Reconstructed remains limited because this is a variadic cdecl helper with provider calls through imports; current BN disassembly and comments are sufficient for functional behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442270 validates a cdecl variadic helper that passes the format string and argument-list address to imported vsprintf with g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressStatusTextBuffer, then returns imported SetDlgItemTextA(g_hWestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog, 1023, buffer).

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_set_status_text_fmt_smoke patches USER32 SetDlgItemTextA and verifies formatted text, control id 1023, progress HWND usage, return value propagation, and that the SetDlgItemTextA text pointer is the recovered global buffer.
